items.value: 9.0"L x2.8"D x7.1"H, 0.9LB. 1 adjustable strap with 23" drop, long enough for crossbody or over the shoulder style

items.label: Practical Design
items.value: 1front pocket design,2 slip pockets and 1 zip pocket inside for well organized and convenient access. The main compartment fits Phone,Keys,Glasses,Long Wallet or other small daily stuff

items.label: Great Looking
items.value: Solid purse but not overly stiff, can stand up on it's own and never flop over, cute but not too small. Dressy and Classic enough while keeping your hands free

items.label: Thoughtful Gift
items.value: A great gift idea for Christmas, Valentine's Day, Birthday, Anniversary, Mother's Day, Thanksgiving Day or any other holiday

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Avoid getting wet or exposing to high heat. Machine wash cotton parts in cold water, gentle cycle, and tumble dry low.
